products.clean_name: Shining Legends Collection: Shiny Darkrai GX

ext_data.CardText:
Each Shining Legends Collection—Shiny Darkrai GX includes:
• 1 holofoil promo card featuring Darkrai GX
• 4 Shining Legends booster packs
• A code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online

The Pokémon TCG: Shining Legends Collector Chest includes:
• 5 Pokémon TCG: Shining Legends booster packs
• 3 holofoil promo cards featuring Pikachu (SM86), Latias (SM87), and Latios (SM88)
• A cool Pokémon coin
• 2 colorful sticker sheets
• A collector's album to store your favorite cards
• A Pokémon notepad and 2 pencils
• A code card for the Pokémon TCG Online

Inside this Shining Legends Elite Trainer Box, you'll find:
• 10 Shining Legends booster packs
• 1 foil promo card featuring Shining Ho-Oh
• 65 card sleeves featuring Ho-Oh
• 45 Energy cards
• 1 player's guide to the Shining Legends expansion
• 6 damage-counter dice
• 1 competition-legal coin-flip die
• 2 acrylic condition markers and 1 acrylic GX marker
• Product can also be used as a collector's box to hold everything, with 4 dividers to keep it organized
• 1 code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online
